components.name: Desktop rail button
components.description: A 32px icon target; selection uses the accent and a stronger white wash.
components.css: .ds-rail-button { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 32px; height: 32px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.11); color: #a5a0ff; } .ds-rail-button svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.5; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-rail-button:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.11); } .ds-rail-button:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #a5a0ff; outline-offset: 0; } .ds-rail-button:disabled { opacity: 0.4; }

components.name: Desktop navigation rail
components.description: Separate icon rails stay narrow beside the flexible preview.
components.css: .ds-nav-rail { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 4px; width: 44px; padding: 8px 0; border-radius: 12px; background: #0d0d0d; } .ds-nav-icon { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 32px; height: 32px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.035); color: #e8e8e8; } .ds-nav-icon:hover, .ds-nav-icon[aria-pressed="true"] { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.11); } .ds-nav-icon[aria-pressed="true"] { color: #a5a0ff; } .ds-nav-icon:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #a5a0ff; } .ds-nav-icon:disabled { opacity: 0.4; } .ds-nav-icon svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.5; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }

components.name: Desktop editable format control
components.description: Editable value with separate suggestion and apply actions.
components.css: .ds-format-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; } .ds-format-input { flex: 1; min-width: 0; height: 30px; padding: 0 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.055); color: #e8e8e8; font: 12px Geist, sans-serif; } .ds-format-input:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #a5a0ff; } .ds-format-action { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 24px; height: 30px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.035); color: #e8e8e8; } .ds-format-action:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.11); } .ds-format-action:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #a5a0ff; } .ds-format-action svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.75; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }

components.name: Desktop floating tool palette
components.description: The selected tool floats over the live preview and scrolls when its controls exceed the available height.

components.css: .ds-tool-palette { position: absolute; top: 16px; right: 52px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; width: 264px; max-height: max(100px, calc(100vh - 108px)); overflow-y: auto; padding: 12px; border-radius: 12px; background: #111111f5; color: #e8e8e8; font: 12px Geist, sans-serif; backdrop-filter: blur(16px); } .ds-tool-caption { color: #a8a8a8; } .ds-tool-select { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; width: 100%; height: 28px; margin-top: 4px; margin-bottom: 8px; padding: 0 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.035); color: #e8e8e8; font: inherit; } .ds-tool-select:hover, .ds-tool-select[aria-pressed="true"] { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.11); } .ds-tool-select:focus-visible, .ds-slider:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #a5a0ff; outline-offset: 0; } .ds-tool-select svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.75; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-slider-label { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; } .ds-slider-value { color: #a8a8a8; } .ds-slider { position: relative; width: 100%; height: 20px; padding: 0 4px; } .ds-slider::before { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: 9px; height: 2px; background: #4b4d55; content: ""; } .ds-slider-fill { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 9px; width: 50%; height: 2px; background: #a5a0ff; } .ds-slider-thumb { position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 4px; margin-left: -4px; width: 8px; height: 12px; border-radius: 2px; background: #cdced4; }

components.name: Android Material 3 primary action
components.description: Native full-width contained action with Android's minimum touch target.
components.css: .ds-android-primary { display: block; width: 100%; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 24px; background: #a5a0ff; color: #060606; font: 14px Geist, sans-serif; } .ds-android-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.04); } .ds-android-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #a5a0ff; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-android-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.38; }

components.name: Android outlined password field
components.description: Material 3 outlined field with a persistent label and native visibility toggle.
components.css: .ds-android-field { display: block; color: #e8e8e8; font: 14px Geist, sans-serif; } .ds-android-field span { display: block; margin-bottom: -8px; padding: 0 4px; width: max-content; background: #060606; color: #a5a0ff; font-size: 12px; } .ds-android-field input { box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; height: 56px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid #626262; border-radius: 4px; background: transparent; color: #e8e8e8; font: inherit; } .ds-android-field input:focus-visible { border: 2px solid #a5a0ff; outline: 0; } .ds-android-field small { display: block; margin: 4px 12px 0; color: #a8a8a8; font-size: 12px; }

narrative.overview:
OpenCam treats the live camera image as the main work surface. The desktop uses Zui and gpui-base in the pinned Zeron visual language: near-black planes, compact labeled controls, separate vertical action and tool rails, and one floating palette for the selected tool. Camera content stays clear while supported floating menus receive a restrained frost treatment.

The Android companion keeps the same neutral palette and Geist family through native Material 3 Views. It is a single, full-width control screen without a redundant app-name toolbar; Android text scaling and scrolling take precedence over desktop density.
keyCharacteristics: Direct preview first, controls kept to the edges.
One lavender accent for desktop selection and focus, and the Android primary action.
Native desktop controls and native Material 3 companion controls.

rules.name: The One-Accent Rule
rules.body: Use the lavender for desktop selection and focus, and for the Android primary action; let the live image hold the visual attention.

rules.name: The Label-First Rule
rules.body: Keep desktop labels at the inherited 12px scale and reserve mono type for live measurements.

rules.name: The Open-Frame Rule
rules.body: Keep the preview flexible, with two slim rails and only the selected tool floating over it.

dos: Do keep the live preview at the center and let it fill the available desktop space.
Do use the supplied Zeron and Solar SVG assets for their applicable controls.
Do keep Android controls at their native 48dp minimum while allowing large text to scroll.
Do keep labels concise and make each icon action accessible by name.
donts: Don't add a permanent settings wall, fixed bottom dock, or redundant app-name toolbar.
Don't add headings or explanatory copy when a direct control label already explains the action.
Don't substitute handmade glyphs, emoji, or text symbols for the shipped vector icons.
Don't add ornamental animation to camera controls or preview surfaces.
Don't blur, crop, or paint decorative imagery over the camera preview.
Don't treat synthetic fixture bars in review captures as the product palette or a real camera feed.
